newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka engineering stocks push prices higher.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka engineering stocks push prices higher.

text.p: Dhaka stocks rose with buying of blue chip engineering stocks when the market reopened after Moslem Friday weekened, brokers said.
Olympic Industry gained 13 taka to 1,400, Aziz Pipe rose 50 to 1,650 and G Q Ball Pen was up 54 at 480.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index closed 15.91 points, or 1.02 percent, higher at 1,562.66 on Thursday on turnover of 151.9 million taka.
